summary: This lesson plan uses the Public Issue Tree / Cause-Effect Diagram to help students in Sri Lanka develop competency level 8.4.5, which involves showing measures to be taken to avoid accidents caused by chemicals. The lesson is structured into three progressive steps, with specific teacher and student activities, learning and teaching methods, and aids. The lesson aims to equip students with the skills to identify and prevent accidents caused by chemicals, and to promote civic engagement and problem-solving in a real-world context.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Teacher assessment and feedback throughout the lesson, peer evaluation during the group sharing and presentation, and a final review of the learning outcomes to assess student understanding and mastery.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Students will be able to explain the measures to be taken to avoid accidents caused by chemicals and demonstrate their understanding through a shared civic artifact or public information message.
